name: prototype-tabular-recipe-notation
description: Static GitHub Pages prototype for rendering recipe URLs as Tabular Recipe Notation graphics.

scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node tests/app.test.js && python3 -m unittest tests/test_trn_renderer.py tests/test_docker_renderer.py tests/test_schema_org_parser.py && python3 -m behave features && python3 tests/check_html.py && python3 tests/check_fixtures.py
scripts.coverage:trn-renderer: python3 -m coverage run --branch --source=trn_renderer --omit='trn_renderer/__main__.py' -m unittest tests/test_trn_renderer.py && python3 -m coverage report --fail-under=100 --show-missing
scripts.coverage:recipe-parser: python3 -m coverage run --branch --source=trn_recipe -m unittest tests/test_schema_org_parser.py && python3 -m coverage report --fail-under=100 --show-missing
